note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God, the adversary and the heavenly court are not pictured, Job and his family are not portrayed as biblical people but shown through ordinary people of today, and nothing violent is shown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

sections.meaning: Job was a man of integrity whose full and blessed life went together with a father's watchful care for his children before God.
ideas: A grey-haired man bows his head in thanks at the head of a long harvest table crowded with his grown children and workers, his fields and herds behind
A man stands on his farmhouse porch at golden evening with his big family round him and pastures full of animals behind
A farmer leans on his gate at sunrise looking out over a flourishing farm that runs to the horizon
A shopkeeper runs after a customer to give back the extra change he was overpaid
At first light a father stands praying at a table still strewn with his grown children's party of the night before
Before dawn a father kneels by a window praying, framed photographs of his children on the sill
A father lies awake late at night with the porch light on until the last of his children's cars comes home
A father watches from a hilltop as the lit windows of his children's houses glow across the valley
A full barn at harvest with every stall and loft filled
A man's weathered hands hold a heavy basket of fruit from his own orchard

sections.meaning: The good man is noticed, and the question is put: does anyone fear God for nothing, or only for what he gets, so his faith will be tested by losing everything.
ideas: In a windswept field of bent, crooked trees one tall straight oak stands upright
A jeweller studies a single flawless stone under a loupe in bright light
A farmhouse ringed on every side by a tall thick hedge, green and lush inside, bare and dry outside
A dog trots obediently at a man's heel, its eyes fixed only on the bag of treats in his hand
A child hugs a visiting uncle while staring at the present in his hands
A gap has opened in the hedge round the farmhouse and a dark storm is rolling toward it
A goldsmith holds a crucible of molten gold in the heart of the furnace flame
A blacksmith plunges a glowing blade into water to test it
A climber's rope is loaded with a heavy weight to see whether it will hold
A bridge has a line of heavy trucks driven onto it to test its strength

sections.meaning: Loss falls upon loss without a pause, each blow arriving before the last has been told, until even his children are gone.
ideas: A man in his farmyard turns as one breathless worker runs up to him, a second already running down the road behind and a third far off
A man opens his front door to a dusty farmhand with a stricken face, cap in hand
Lightning splits the sky over a hillside pasture where the grass burns in a long line of flame
A barn burns at night while a farmer watches far off with his hands on his head
A big corral stands empty at dusk, its gate hanging open and the ground churned with hoofprints
A farmer stands alone in an empty paddock holding an empty halter
A storm has torn the roof off a house and a long table laid for a celebration stands with empty chairs under the grey sky
An old man's hands hold a family photograph in a cracked frame in a storm-wrecked room
A row of dominoes falls one after another
A telephone rings and rings on a kitchen table while another rings in the hall

sections.meaning: Stripped of everything, Job falls down and worships: we come with nothing and go with nothing, the Lord gave and has taken, blessed be his name.
ideas: A grey-haired man kneels with his forehead to the floor of a bare emptied room in quiet dawn light
A man kneels in a burnt empty field at sunrise, his face lifted and his hands open
An old man's open empty hands, palms up, lifted toward a bright morning sky
A newborn's tiny hand curls round an old man's finger
A man stands in the ruins of his house with his head bowed and his hand on his heart
Empty hands let a handful of sand run out into the wind
A man walks away from a ruined farm toward the sunrise, empty-handed and upright
An empty cradle beside an empty chair in morning light
A man sets the one cup left to him on the table and gives thanks
The tide carries away footprints on a beach at dawn

scenes.principle: Job was blameless and upright, he feared God, and his life was full of children and plenty.
scenes.shows: A grey-haired man bows his head in thanks at the head of a long harvest table crowded with his grown children and workers, his pastures and herds behind.
scenes.prompt: At a long wooden table set outdoors beside a farmhouse at golden evening, a big family of grown sons and daughters and farm workers sit together over a harvest meal. At the head of the table a grey-haired man in a plain shirt bows his head in thanks, and everyone round the table has bowed with him. Behind them wide green pastures full of grazing sheep and cattle stretch away to the hills.

scenes.principle: A father who rises early to pray for his children, in case they have sinned against God.
scenes.shows: Before dawn a grey-haired father kneels in prayer at a window lined with photographs of his grown sons and daughters.
scenes.prompt: Before dawn, in a quiet room lit only by one small lamp, a grey-haired father kneels at a window with his hands clasped and his head bowed in prayer. On the window sill in front of him stand a row of framed photographs of his grown sons and daughters. Outside the window the sky is just turning pale.

scenes.principle: There is no one like him on the earth: blameless and upright.
scenes.shows: In a windswept field of bent, crooked trees one tall oak stands perfectly straight.
scenes.prompt: A wide open field on a windswept hill under a clear sky. Every tree in the field has been bent and twisted crooked by the wind, leaning low. In the middle stands one tall oak, perfectly straight and upright, green and strong, the only one of its kind. Clear daylight picks it out.

scenes.principle: Is his faith for nothing, or only because he has been hedged round and blessed on every side?
scenes.shows: A farmhouse and its lush fields are enclosed on every side by a thick green hedge, with bare dry land all round.
scenes.prompt: Seen from a little above, a farmhouse with its barns, orchard and green fields is enclosed on every side by a tall, thick, unbroken green hedge. Inside the hedge everything is lush, flowering and fruitful, with cattle grazing. Outside the hedge the land all round is bare, dry and brown. Bright sunlight.

scenes.principle: Take away all that he has, and see whether he will still bless God.
scenes.shows: A gap has been opened in the hedge round the farmhouse and a dark storm is rolling toward it.
scenes.prompt: Seen from a little above, a farmhouse in lush green fields is enclosed by a tall thick green hedge, but on one side a wide gap has been opened in the hedge. Through the gap, across the bare brown land outside, a huge dark storm front with rain and wind is rolling straight toward the house. The house is still in sunlight.

scenes.principle: Bad news comes upon bad news, each arriving before the last is told.
scenes.shows: A farmer turns in alarm as a breathless young worker runs up to him, with a second and a third already running down the road behind.
scenes.prompt: In a farmyard in daylight a grey-haired farmer turns in alarm as a breathless young worker runs up to him, dusty, his face stricken. Behind them, a second young man is already running down the farm road toward them, and a third, further off, is running too. The farmer's hand is raised to his mouth.

scenes.principle: Even what came from the sky took everything away.
scenes.shows: Lightning strikes down on an empty hillside pasture and the grass burns in a long line of flame.
scenes.prompt: A dark storm sky over a wide hillside pasture. A great fork of lightning strikes down from the clouds, and the dry grass of the pasture is burning in a long line of flame and smoke across the hill. The pasture is empty, with no animals and no people. The lightning and flames light the scene.

scenes.principle: All his wealth is carried off.
scenes.shows: An empty corral at sunset, its gate broken open and the ground churned with hoofprints leading away.
scenes.prompt: A large wooden corral on open farmland at dusk, utterly empty. Its gate has been torn open and hangs crooked on one hinge, and the dusty ground inside and out is churned with countless hoofprints all leading away toward the empty hills. No animal and no person anywhere.

scenes.principle: Last and worst, his children are taken while they feast together.
scenes.shows: A storm has torn the roof off a house; a table still laid for a celebration, with a cake, stands among empty and overturned chairs.
scenes.prompt: A family house after a great windstorm: the roof and one wall have been torn away, and the dining room stands open to a grey sky. In it a long table is still laid for a celebration, with plates, glasses and a cake, but every chair round it is empty and some are knocked over. Broken roof beams and leaves lie about. No people anywhere.

scenes.principle: Stripped of everything, Job falls to the ground and worships.
scenes.shows: In a bare, emptied room at dawn a grey-haired man kneels with his forehead to the floor.
scenes.prompt: In a bare, emptied room in quiet dawn light, a grey-haired man in a plain shirt kneels and bows all the way down with his forehead to the wooden floor, his open hands resting on the floor beside his head, in worship. Soft light falls on him from a single window. The room has nothing else in it.

scenes.principle: We bring nothing and take nothing: the Lord gave, the Lord has taken, and his name is blessed.
scenes.shows: An old man's empty open hands are lifted toward the sunrise.
scenes.prompt: A close view of an old man's weathered, empty hands, held open with palms up and lifted toward a bright morning sky full of soft golden light. Nothing is in them. Beyond them, out of focus, a wide open landscape at sunrise.
